summary: validate_argument_spec validates role or task arguments against a spec; it's unnecessary for roles that already define an argument spec.
questions: How do I validate variables passed to a task file?
Do I need validate_argument_spec if my role has meta/argument_specs.yml?

answer_card.title: Validate arguments
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.validate_argument_spec` checks variables against an argument spec. Roles with an `argument_specs` file are validated automatically, so you don't need to call it there.
